issues.legal_issue: A homicide committed during a sudden fight without premeditation, undue advantage, or cruel or unusual conduct falls within Exception 4 to the definition of murder.
material_facts: A dispute over a tree led to a verbal altercation and then a fight; the fatal injuries were inflicted in the heat of passion.
The accused had not come prepared for an attack, and the earlier land dispute had not involved physical combat.
The injuries were inflicted at random, and there was no evidence that the deceased was further injured after falling and becoming helpless.
One injury was sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death, but the manner of the assault was not cruel or unusual.
issues.conclusion: Exception 4 applied. The murder conviction was replaced with a conviction for culpable homicide not amounting to murder, and the court imposed a custodial sentence of ten years and a fine.
issues.legal_principle: Under Exception 4 to Section 300 of the Indian Penal Code, homicide is excluded from murder when it is committed without premeditation in a sudden fight, in the heat of passion upon a sudden quarrel, without the offender taking undue advantage or acting cruelly or unusually. A sudden fight involves a combat between two or more persons; heat of passion allows no time for passions to cool. All ingredients must be established, and undue advantage means unfair advantage. The court relied on Sukhbir Singh v. State of Haryana (2002) 3 SCC 327.

rule.if: criminal_appeal_against_murder_conviction and no_premeditation and sudden_fight_with_person_killed and heat_of_passion_without_time_to_cool and not undue_advantage and not cruel_or_unusual_conduct

predicates.criminal_appeal_against_murder_convictio: The accused appealed a conviction for murder.
predicates.no_premeditation: The accused had not previously planned or prepared to commit the homicide.
predicates.sudden_fight_with_person_killed: A fight suddenly occurred between the accused and the person who was killed.
predicates.heat_of_passion_without_time_to_cool: The quarrel and ensuing fight inflamed the participants before there was time for their passions to cool.
predicates.undue_advantage: The accused took an unfair advantage during the fight.
predicates.cruel_or_unusual_conduct: The accused acted in a cruel or unusual manner during the homicide.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges a murder conviction and the homicide occurred without premeditation in a sudden fight with the person killed, in heat of passion without time to cool, and without unfair advantage or cruel or unusual conduct, the homicide is culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
